description.value: Reposados is a Mexican taco restaurant in the Kootenays region of BC, serving fresh authentic tacos alongside an extensive tequila and cocktail selection. The bar component and breadth of menu options — including vegan and vegetarian choices — make it a solid stop for touring cyclists looking for a substantial, flexible meal with a drink option. Its location in a small mountain community gives it a local character that distinguishes it from generic chain dining.
